title: Descarreaux 2008: total trunk angle at FRP onset and cessation, by fatigue and load (ES L2, L5)
condition: standing flexion-extension; no fatigue vs fatigue (Sorensen); no load vs 12 kg

quantity.name: total trunk angle at FRP onset (EMG silence begins in flexion) and FRP cessation (EMG returns in extension)
quantity.definition: total trunk flexion angle (deg) at the instant of ES myoelectric silence onset/cessation; main-effect means (pooled over the other factor); +/- as printed (text gives no SD/SEM label)

source.authors: Descarreaux M, Lafond D, Jeffrey-Gauthier R, Centomo H, Cantin V
source.sample: 20 healthy adults (9 M, 11 F) without LBP

protocol.summary: 3 trials x 4 conditions (no fatigue/no load, no fatigue/load, fatigue/no load, fatigue/load).
how_to_simulate: Quasi-static trunk flexion to maximum (knees ~168 deg, i.e. nearly straight) and return
Hand load: none, or 12 kg barbell held with elbows at 90 deg, upper arms along the trunk
Output: trunk angle at which modelled ES activation at L2/L5 level falls below threshold (onset) and rises again (cessation)
protocol.notes: Surface Ag-AgCl EMG bilaterally over erector spinae at L2 and L5 levels (Merletti orientation), 900 Hz, 10-450 Hz band-pass; rectified, normalised to MVC (%MVC, LIDO dynamometer, 20 deg hip/trunk flexion). Onset/cessation of silence by visual inspection of the rectified EMG. Kinematics: Optotrak LEDs on acromion, mid iliac crest, greater trochanter, lateral knee, lateral malleolus; 'total trunk angle' (not further defined in the text). Task: 5 s flexion to maximum, 3 s hold, 5 s extension (auditory cue), arms by the side; load: 12 kg barbell with elbows flexed 90 deg and upper arms along the trunk (light plastic panel replica when unloaded); fatigue: Sorensen test to exhaustion (138 +/- 37 s).

extraction.from: Descarreaux 2008 Results text p.4-5 (fatigue effect, same values as Fig 3) and Fig 4 (load effect, digitised)
extraction.uncertainty: text rows exact; Fig 4 rows +/-0.5 deg (300 dpi, 10.5 px/deg); n in fatigue rows inferred from the ANOVA df (F1,16 -> 17; F1,15 -> 16)
extraction.check_notes: Digitisation validated on Fig 3 (same axes) against the text: L2 onset no fatigue 85.0 vs 84.9, L5 74.9 vs 74.7. Fig 4 caption says 'no fatigue = black; fatigue = grey' (copy error) - black = no load, grey = load per the text ('significant increase in FRP onset angle during loading'). | verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (text p.4-5 fatigue values exact; Fig 4 bars re-read 79.3/82.9/69.9/75.3, 88.6/89.9/87.2/89.8 within +/-0.5 deg)

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (angles); for SEM-reported data use SD = SEM x sqrt(n)
